lines.en: label rindorm50:
I knock on Rin’s door, but immediately upon ending my ritualistic five knocks, I notice an unusual noise coming from inside.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Rin 的门，可刚结束我那套仪式性的五下敲门，就听见里面传来一阵不寻常的动静。

lines.en: And, of course, due to the volume of that noise, she’s unable to hear me and let me in- banishing me to a night in the hall with nothing to do.
lines.zh: 当然了，那动静太大，她根本听不见我、也没法来开门——于是我被放逐到走廊上，度过一个无事可做的夜晚。

lines.en: Defeated, I slide my hands into my pockets and head home.
lines.zh: 我败下阵来，双手插进口袋，转身回家。

lines.en: scene black
Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: I’ve never let a door stop me before and I don’t intend to start doing so now.
lines.zh: 我还从来没被一扇门拦住过，也不打算从今天开始。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar1
Besides, the “unusual noise” was just these two lovebirds(?) playing guitar and ignoring my role as the person they are supposed to be falling in love with instead of one another.
lines.zh: 再说了，那「不寻常的动静」不过是这对小情侣（？）在弹吉他，把我这个本该被她们爱上、而不是让她们爱上彼此的角色给晾在了一边。

lines.en: Not that I want their “love” or anything.
lines.zh: 倒不是说我想要她们的「爱」什么的。

lines.en: Their bodies would suffice.
lines.zh: 身体就足够了。

lines.en: But alas. Lesbians.
lines.zh: 可惜啊。女同性恋。

lines.en: : Yo! Here to jam with us, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哟！来跟我们一起玩音乐吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Sorry. I left my guitar at home.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我把吉他落家里了。

lines.en: : Wait...you don’t actually play, do you?
lines.zh: : 等等……你根本不会弹吧？

lines.en: : I do not. That was what those of us in show business call a “joke.”
lines.zh: : 不会。我们这行的管那个叫「玩笑」。

lines.en: : Damn. For a split second, I thought you might actually be cool.
lines.zh: : 靠。有那么一瞬间，我还以为你真的挺酷的。

lines.en: : Okay, Rin. You’ve had your fun. Time to break up with Otoha.
lines.zh: : 行了，Rin。玩也玩够了。该跟 Otoha 分手了。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar2
: I refuse! Have you {i}seen{/i} how cute she is in those pajamas?! Her thighs are like “BAM!”
lines.zh: : 我拒绝！你没{i}看见{/i}她穿那身睡衣有多可爱吗？！她的大腿简直就是「砰！」

lines.en: : Ain’t no way I’m giving that up, homie!
lines.zh: : 哥们儿，这种好事我怎么可能放手啊！

lines.en: : You know, I thought all of the commentary on my appearance might mellow out once we started dating...but I’m pretty sure it’s actually gone the complete opposite way.
lines.zh: : 说起来，我还以为我们开始交往以后，你对我外表的那些评论会收敛一点……但我敢肯定情况完全反过来了。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar3
: Am I really that bad?
lines.zh: : 我真的那么糟糕吗？

lines.en: : I mean...I kinda knew what I was getting myself into.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我大概早就知道会是这样。

lines.en: : It would be nice if you’d wait a little longer before openly admitting to wanting to see how I look without my clothes on, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是能再多等一阵子，再公开承认想看我不穿衣服的样子，那就更好了。

lines.en: : Smooth, Rin.
lines.zh: : 真顺溜啊，Rin。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar4
: Wait, no! I definitely didn’t say that! Did I think it? Of course! But I’ve been getting a lot better at not screaming my thoughts out when Otoha is around!
lines.zh: : 等等，不对！我绝对没说过那句话！我想过吗？当然想过！但我已经进步很多了，至少 Otoha 在的时候不会把心里话喊出来了！

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : Just give it a rest, dude. Neither one of us is gonna change her. She’s too set in her ways.
lines.zh: : 算了吧，老兄。我们谁也改不了她。她这人已经定型了。

lines.en: : I am surprised you were willing to accept that part of her.
lines.zh: : 我倒是挺意外你愿意接受她这一部分。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar5
: Woah! Rude.
lines.zh: : 哇哦！好过分。

lines.en: : Eh. It was bound to happen sooner or later.
lines.zh: : 嗯。早晚的事。

lines.en: : I’ll admit that it happened...a {i}lot{/i} sooner than I would have expected, but it’s not like I was ever gonna just reject her when she’s been pushier than anyone I’ve ever met.
lines.zh: : 我承认……这比我预想的来得早{i}太多{/i}了，不过她比我这辈子见过的任何人都主动，我也不可能就这么拒绝她。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar6
: It looks like sometimes...all you need is a little persistence.
lines.zh: : 看来有时候……你需要的只是一点点坚持。

lines.en: : Or a lot of persistence.
lines.zh: : 或者很多很多坚持。

lines.en: : And a group of friends who are willing to put up with your nonsense as you prepare yourself for imminent destruction only to be turned into like, the third happiest girl in[school].
lines.zh: : 再加上一群愿意容忍你胡闹的朋友，看着你为即将到来的毁灭做准备，结果却变成了 [school] 里第三幸福的女生。

lines.en: : Who are the first two?
lines.zh: : 前两名是谁？

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar7
: Uta and Miku, obviously. I could get like ten girlfriends and still not be as energetic as either of them.
lines.zh: : 当然是 Uta 和 Miku。我就算交十个女朋友，也没她们俩中任何一个有活力。

lines.en: : Uhh...let’s try to stick to just one girlfriend for now, okay?
lines.zh: : 呃……眼下咱们先只有一个女朋友，好吗？

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar8
: Yes, ma’am!
lines.zh: : 遵命，长官！

lines.en: : Wow. You two have barely even started dating and you’ve already got her wrapped around your finger.
lines.zh: : 哇。你们俩才刚在一起没多久，你就把她拿捏得死死的了。

lines.en: : Yeah but, to be fair, she kind of wrapped herself around it before I even knew what was going on.
lines.zh: : 是没错，不过说句公道话，在我还没搞清楚状况之前，她自己就缠上来了。

lines.en: : Well, all things considered, you’re very cool about the whole thing. So thanks.
lines.zh: : 嗯，总的来说，你对整件事的态度挺酷的。谢了。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar9
: Wait, why are you thanking me? That just makes it sound like I’m doing this as a favor to you.
lines.zh: : 等等，你谢我干嘛？这么说好像我是在卖你人情似的。

lines.en: : You do know I actually...{i}do{/i} like Rin, right? Just...not as much as she likes me. Yet. I think.
lines.zh: : 你知道我真的……{i}喜欢{/i} Rin 的吧？只是……没有她喜欢我那么深。目前是。我觉得。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Just don’t thank me.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。反正别谢我就对了。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == False:
: I’m pretty sure Sensei is just glad that I don’t have to keep bothering him with all of my obsessions and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Sensei 只是高兴，我再也不用拿那些执念什么的去烦他了。

lines.en: : I don’t mind your obsessions. I’m just happy you’re not about to explode anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不介意你的执念。我只是高兴你不会再随时爆炸了。

lines.en: : If there’s anything you should know about girls like me, it's that we’re ready to explode at any given moment, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，关于我这样的女生，有件事你该知道：我们随时都准备好要爆炸。

lines.en: : Just now, it will be a...technicolored happiness explosion. Or something.
lines.zh: : 只不过这一次，会是一场……五彩斑斓的幸福爆炸。大概吧。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: else:
: I’m pretty sure Sensei is just a little impressed because I managed to get a girlfriend he hasn’t already stuck his fingers inside.
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Sensei 只是有点佩服我，居然能交到一个他还没把手指伸进去过的女朋友。

lines.en: : I don’t like how you can say that with a smile on your face.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你笑眯眯地说出这种话。

lines.en: : What can I say? It’s easy to fake a smile when you’ve already desensitized yourself to the feeling of betrayal.
lines.zh: : 能说什么呢？只要早就把背叛的感觉麻木掉了，装个笑脸很容易。

lines.en: : Yeah so...about...{i}not{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，所以……那个……{i}不提{/i}这个了。

lines.en: : So, anyway, how come you’re willing to play guitar for Otoha and not me?
lines.zh: : 那话说回来，你为什么愿意给 Otoha 弹吉他，却不给我弹？

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar10
: Uhhhhhhh...because girlfriend?
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃……因为女朋友？

lines.en: : I’d jump off a bridge if Otoha asked me to.
lines.zh: : 只要 Otoha 开口，让我跳桥我都跳。

lines.en: : First off, no. Don’t do that.
lines.zh: : 首先，别。别跳。

lines.en: : Second, have you really never heard her play before?
lines.zh: : 其次，你真的一次都没听过她弹？

lines.en: : You’ve heard {i}me{/i} play before and I barely even know you.
lines.zh: : 你跟我才认识多久，{i}我{/i}都听你弹过了。

lines.en: : True. But Rin doesn’t really wander off to parks and play for tips.
lines.zh: : 确实。不过 Rin 不太会跑到公园里去卖艺。

lines.en: : I just remember suggesting that she play for me sometime and...she’s yet to actually do it.
lines.zh: : 我只记得我跟她提过，让她找个时间弹给我听……可她到现在也没弹。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar11
: Oh, yeah! I remember that! It was one of the first times you came to my room, I think.
lines.zh: : 哦，对！我想起来了！那好像是你最早几次来我房间的时候。

lines.en: : Wow, that feels like forever ago now.
lines.zh: : 哇，感觉像是很久以前的事了。

lines.en: : Nah. Just three school years.
lines.zh: : 不。才三个学年而已。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar12
: Three...school years...
lines.zh: : 三个……学年……

lines.en: : You weren’t her middle[school] teacher as well, were you?
lines.zh: : 你之前也不是她 middle[school] 的老师吧？

lines.en: : Nope. Time is just a construct that we’re free to manipulate and measure however we want because it doesn’t actually exist and is entirely subjective.
lines.zh: : 不是。时间不过是个概念，我们爱怎么摆弄、怎么衡量都行，因为它其实并不存在，完全是主观的。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : But...we already came up with a way to measure it?
lines.zh: : 可是……我们已经想出衡量它的办法了？

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar13
: You doing okay over there?
lines.zh: : 你那边还好吗？

lines.en: : Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin？

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar14
: Oh! Yeah! Sorry. Just got lost in thought for a second.
lines.zh: : 哦！没事！抱歉。就是走神了一下。

lines.en: : Time really does fly sometimes, huh?
lines.zh: : 时间有时候真的过得很快，是吧？

lines.en: : It really does. Even I feel like I’ve known Sensei longer than I actually have, but...I guess that’s just part of being young?
lines.zh: : 确实。连我自己都觉得认识 Sensei 的时间比实际要长，不过……我想这就是年轻的好处吧？

lines.en: : Ahh, yes.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。

lines.en: : I, too, am young.
lines.zh: : 我也很年轻。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar15
: Sure are, bud. Hang in there.
lines.zh: : 那是当然，兄弟。撑住。

lines.en: : We’re rooting for your health, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我们都在为你的健康加油呢，Sensei。

lines.en: : Guys, I’m only thirty-one. That’s really not that old.
lines.zh: : 各位，我才三十一。真没那么老。

lines.en: : Nonsense. Thirty is when [young]people become old.
lines.zh: : 胡说。三十岁就是 [young]人变老的分界线。

lines.en: : You’re going to change that number to forty when you’re in your twenties and you know it.
lines.zh: : 等你二十几岁的时候，肯定会把这个数字改成四十，你自己心里清楚。

lines.en: : No way, man. Otoha and I are gonna stay [young]forever. We refuse to grow up.
lines.zh: : 才不会，老兄。我和 Otoha 要永远 [young]下去。我们拒绝长大。

lines.en: : Yolo and all that stuff. You know.
lines.zh: : Yolo 那一套嘛。你懂的。

lines.en: Welp, in a world full of shattered wishes, I guess one or two were bound to come true.
lines.zh: 好吧，在这个满是破碎愿望的世界里，总有一两个会实现。

lines.en: Because there’s definitely no way either of them is growing up anytime soon.
lines.zh: 因为她们俩显然短期内是不会长大的。

lines.en: Well, at least not physically.
lines.zh: 至少身体上不会。

lines.en: I’m sure there’s still enough trauma to go around for both of them to get a little older in the vague sense of maturity.
lines.zh: 我敢说，够分摊的创伤还是有的，足以让她们在心智这个模糊的层面上成熟一点。

lines.en: But for now, I don’t see any harm in letting them enjoy their time together.
lines.zh: 但眼下，让她们享受在一起的时光也没什么坏处。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar16
: Welp, I guess it’s time for me to get going.
lines.zh: : 好啦，我差不多该走了。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: Or not.
lines.zh: 或许还不走。

lines.en: It looks like I may have spoken too soon.
lines.zh: 看来我说得太早了。

lines.en: : Yeah...I guess so.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概是吧。

lines.en: : Have fun talking to your mom. Tell her I said hi even though I’ve never met her before. I’m sure that won’t be weird or anything.
lines.zh: : 跟你妈妈聊得开心。替我向她问好，虽然我从没见过她。我敢肯定那一点都不奇怪。

lines.en: : It will. But okay.
lines.zh: : 会很奇怪。不过行吧。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar17
: Night, man.
lines.zh: : 晚安，老兄。

lines.en: : Try not to creep on Rin too much, okay? She’s taken now.
lines.zh: : 尽量别老缠着 Rin，好吗？她现在名花有主了。

lines.en: : Isn’t everything I do creepy to you?
lines.zh: : 我做什么事在你眼里不 creepy 吗？

lines.en: : Kinda, yeah. But you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，是啊。但你懂我意思。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar18
: Goodnight again!
lines.zh: : 再说一次晚安！

lines.en: : See you guys in[school]!
lines.zh: : [school] 见！

lines.en: : Night...
lines.zh: : 晚安……

lines.en: Otoha disappears into the hall and Rin stays silent for a moment, likely wishing that she’d gotten to spend a little more time alone with her before I showed up.
lines.zh: Otoha 消失在走廊里，Rin 沉默了一会儿，大概是遗憾在我出现之前没能跟她多单独待一会儿。

lines.en: But it looks like I get the pleasure of taking up the rest of her evening now, so at least I managed to come out on top in some form tonight.
lines.zh: 不过看来今晚剩下的时间归我享用了，所以至少在某种意义上，我今晚还是赢了。

lines.en: : Do you ever just...look at something and think like, “Damn. You’re too good for this world.”
lines.zh: : 你有没有过这种时候……就看着某样东西，然后想，「靠。你对这个世界来说太好了。」

lines.en: : I’m looking at something just like that right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在正看着那样东西。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar19
: Woah! Nice one, Sensei! You’ve got some game after all.
lines.zh: : 哇哦！漂亮啊，Sensei！你还是有本事的嘛。

lines.en: : Now, go use it on somebody who isn’t holding out hope that their girlfriend gives up on taking their relationship slow and bumps things up to the next level right away!
lines.zh: : 那现在拿这套去用在不该用的人身上吧，别用在我身上了，我还盼着我女朋友能放弃慢慢来、赶紧把关系推进到下一步呢！

lines.en: : Still no progress on that end?
lines.zh: : 这方面还是没进展？

lines.en: scene black
I take a seat on the bed and Rin places her guitar on the floor, switching off the amplifier so that we are not destroyed by a wave of feedback.
lines.zh: 我在床上坐下，Rin 把吉他放到地上，关掉音箱，免得一阵啸叫把我们震死。

lines.en: Immediately, she turns to me and picks up right where we left off.
lines.zh: 她立刻转向我，从刚才断掉的地方接了下去。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar20
: No progress yet. But I’m probably just making myself sound a little more desperate than I actually am.
lines.zh: : 还没进展。不过我大概把自己说得比实际更饥渴了一点。

lines.en: : I don’t mind waiting at all.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不介意等。

lines.en: : Do I dislike it? Yuuuuuuuup.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌等吗？讨——厌——。

lines.en: : But I’ve waited years to actually have a girlfriend and, now that I have one, I wanna do things right. You know?
lines.zh: : 可我等了好几年才真的交到女朋友，现在既然有了，我就想把事情做对。你懂吧？

lines.en: : Well, you clearly have more willpower than I do.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你显然比我有自制力。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
scene rinotohaguitar21
: Gee, you think?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你这么觉得？

lines.en: : Literally everyone in the world has more willpower than you if your response to a friend asking you to try and keep your hands off someone is to go and immediately finger them.
lines.zh: : 朋友求你管住自己的手、别碰某个人，你的回应是转头就去用手指把人家弄了，要说自制力，这世界上随便谁都比你强。

lines.en: : It wasn’t immediate-
lines.zh: : 那也不是马上去的——

lines.en: : I don’t fucking care what it was. You promised me something and then proceeded to break that promise without even a second thought.
lines.zh: : 我才他妈不管是不是马上去的。你答应过我的事，然后想都不想就违背了。

lines.en: : You’re a shitty friend with zero willpower and it’s a miracle I managed to win over Otoha before you tried ruining that too.
lines.zh: : 你是个没有一点自制力的烂朋友，我能在你把它也毁掉之前追到 Otoha，简直是个奇迹。

lines.en: : Can’t I just be happy for you this time?
lines.zh: : 这次我就不能单纯为你高兴吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. {i}Can{/i} you?
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道。你{i}能{/i}吗？

lines.en: : I’m...going to try.
lines.zh: : 我……会试试。

lines.en: : Well...I hope you succeed.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那祝你能做到。

lines.en: else:
scene rinotohaguitar21
: Yeah. I guess that isn’t really one of your strong suits.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我猜这确实不是你的强项之一。

lines.en: : But hey, you’ve never tried hooking up with me despite like six million opportunities, so that’s cool.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，那么多次机会你也没真跟我搞上，这点还是挺不错的。

lines.en: : I mean...we {i}did{/i} kiss once.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我们亲过一次。

lines.en: : Yeah. We were right here when it happened. I remember it well.
lines.zh: : 是啊。就在这儿，当时。我记得很清楚。

lines.en: : But that’s a thing of the past. And once Otoha is ready, I’m going to fill my mind with six million more kisses from her and try and push the one with you out.
lines.zh: : 但那都是过去的事了。等 Otoha 准备好了，我要用她的六百万个吻把脑子填满，把跟你那个吻挤出去。

lines.en: : Woah. Rude. That seemed like a big moment for us.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。好过分。那对我们来说可是个大事啊。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar22
: Because it {i}was.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为那时候{i}确实是{/i}。

lines.en: : But it’s not anymore.
lines.zh: : 但现在不是了。

lines.en: : And if we’re going to keep being friends...that’s something we should try our best to understand.
lines.zh: : 如果我们还要继续做朋友……这一点我们最好都尽量想明白。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar23
: Buuuuuuut...that’s enough of the serious stuff for now.
lines.zh: : 不——过——呢……严肃的话题就到此为止。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar24
: Rin Rokuhara is in better shape than ever and ready for whatever curveballs life throws at her!
lines.zh: : Rin Rokuhara 现在的状况前所未有的好，随时准备好接住生活扔过来的任何变化球！

lines.en: : There’s absolutely nothing you can say that could bring me down right now! I’m on top of the world.
lines.zh: : 你现在说什么都没法让我低落！我就站在世界之巅。

lines.en: : Does Molly know yet?
lines.zh: : Molly 知道了吗？

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar25
: Oh, god damnit.
lines.zh: : 哦，妈的。

lines.en: : I’m going to take that as a yes.
lines.zh: : 那我就当是知道了。

lines.en: : You knew, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你早就知道了，对吧？

lines.en: : Knew what? I have no idea where things stand with you two and have a history of revealing more than I should in situations like this.
lines.zh: : 知道什么？我根本不知道你俩现在什么状况，而且在这种场合我说漏嘴的前科可不少。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar26
: Hah...
: Molly and I are taking a little break from each other right now.
lines.zh: : 我和 Molly 现在暂时分开冷静一下。

lines.en: : And since you brought her up specifically, I’m sure you know why.
lines.zh: : 既然你专门提起她，我敢肯定你知道为什么。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : Why didn’t you tell me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不告诉我？

lines.en: : I didn’t really think it was my place to get involved.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这不太该由我来插手。

lines.en: : But you’ve been getting involved in {i}my{/i} lovelife since day one.
lines.zh: : 可从第一天起你就一直插手{i}我的{/i}感情生活。

lines.en: : Correction: You have been dragging me into your lovelife since day one.
lines.zh: : 更正一下：是从第一天起你就一直把我拖进你的感情生活。

lines.en: : Same difference, dude. It would have saved us a huge fight if you’d only let me know about how she felt beforehand.
lines.zh: : 差不多啦，老兄。你要是早点告诉我她的感受，我们就能少吵一大架了。

lines.en: : You’re not actually blaming {i}me{/i} for this, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是在怪{i}我{/i}吧？

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar27
: No...I’m not blaming anyone for anything.
lines.zh: : 不……我没在怪任何人。

lines.en: : In hindsight, it was really fucking obvious and I feel like an idiot for not realizing it.
lines.zh: : 现在回头看，那真是他妈的再明显不过了，我觉得自己没早点发现，蠢得要命。

lines.en: : But, like...
lines.zh: : 但是，就是……

lines.en: : On the opposite of things, I could {i}not{/i} have made it {i}any more obvious{/i} that I don’t see Molly as someone I want to {i}be{/i} with.
lines.zh: : 反过来说，我「不把 Molly 当成想{i}交往{/i}的对象」这件事，也已经表现得{i}不能再明显{/i}了。

lines.en: : I guess you two are just good at...conveniently misunderstanding one another?
lines.zh: : 我猜你俩只是很擅长……心照不宣地互相误解？

lines.en: : How hard is it to understand, “I don’t see you as anything more than a friend and I hate that you stole my first kiss from me?”
lines.zh: : 「我把你当朋友仅此而已，而且我很讨厌你偷走了我的初吻」这句话有什么难懂的？

lines.en: : I’ve told Molly so many times that I don’t look at her that way...and then she goes and fucking tackles me to the ground when I’m {i}on my way to confess to another girl{/i} and tries to kiss me.
lines.zh: : 我跟 Molly 说过无数次，我对她没那种想法……结果我在{i}去跟另一个女生告白的路上{/i}，她他妈直接把我扑倒在地，还想亲我。

lines.en: : What the fuck am I supposed to do, man? She intentionally threw me into a situation she knew I didn’t want to be in and expected me to just...accommodate her.
lines.zh: : 我到底该怎么办啊，老兄？她故意把我扔进一个明知我不想待的处境里，然后指望我……顺着她。

lines.en: : Like...it sounds rude when I say it like this...but take a fucking hint. You know?
lines.zh: : 就是……我这么说可能听着很冲……但你他妈倒是识趣点啊。你懂吧？

lines.en: : I get that you can’t help who you fall for and stuff...I fall easier than anyone.
lines.zh: : 我知道人没法控制自己喜欢上谁……我自己就比谁都容易陷进去。

lines.en: : But if someone tells you waaaaay ahead of time, “I don’t want this,” you can {i}absolutely{/i} help trying to force it on them anyway.
lines.zh: : 但如果有人早早就跟你说了「我不要这个」，那你{i}绝对{/i}可以不去硬塞给人家。

lines.en: : Just to be clear, I’m not trying to get involved in whatever is going on with you two.
lines.zh: : 先说清楚，我不是想插手你俩之间的事。

lines.en: : Nothing. Nothing is going on. Because if anything {i}were{/i} to go on, I’d have to drag Otoha into it. And I don’t want to do that to her.
lines.zh: : 没什么事。真的没有。因为{i}真要{/i}有什么，我就得把 Otoha 也牵扯进来。我不想让她承受这些。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I just like both you and Molly and wouldn’t want either of you to stay upset for longer than a necessary amount of time.
lines.zh: : 那就好。我只是喜欢你，也喜欢 Molly，不想让你们任何一个难过超过必要的时间。

lines.en: scene rinotohaguitar28
: What is the “necessary amount of time” we’re supposed to be upset for?
lines.zh: : 那我们该难过的「必要的时间」是多久？

lines.en: : Any amount of time that doesn’t start negatively influencing the people around you.
lines.zh: : 只要不开始对你周围的人产生负面影响，多久都行。

lines.en: : Boy, do I have bad news for you.
lines.zh: : 哎，我这儿可是有个坏消息要告诉你。

lines.en: : Mental illnesses or whatever don’t count. That’s something you can’t help.
lines.zh: : 心理疾病什么的另算。那种事你控制不了。

lines.en: : Yeah...
scene rinotohaguitar29
: Yeah...speaking of that...
lines.zh: : 嗯……说起这个……

lines.en: : Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哎哟。

lines.en: : You, like...
lines.zh: : 你就是……

lines.en: : You have a hard time being happy sometimes too, right?
lines.zh: : 你有时候也很难快乐起来，对吧？

lines.en: : I try not to really think about it.
lines.zh: : 我尽量不去想这件事。

lines.en: : It’s like...
lines.zh: : 就好比……

lines.en: : It’s just weird.
lines.zh: : 就是很奇怪。

lines.en: : Because...
lines.zh: : 因为……

lines.en: : Because everything will be totally fine. And you’ll have literally no reason to {i}not{/i} be happy.
lines.zh: : 因为一切明明都好好的。你根本没有任何{i}不{/i}开心的理由。

lines.en: : And so you try to be.
lines.zh: : 所以你努力让自己开心。

lines.en: : You try really hard because that’s how you know you {i}want{/i} to feel. Or how you {i}should{/i} feel.
lines.zh: : 你特别努力，因为那就是你{i}想{/i}有的感觉。或者说你{i}应该{/i}有的感觉。

lines.en: : But then-
lines.zh: : 可然后——

lines.en: : All of a sudden-
lines.zh: : 突然之间——

lines.en: scene black
: It’s just nothing.
lines.zh: : 就什么都没有了。

lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}
